It appears there might be a slight mix-up in the company name. **Tecnomed Brasil** is a local Brazilian industrial/manufacturing support operation (located in Tijucas, Santa Catarina), rather than a major widely-known medical brand distributor. However, you might be thinking of **Technomed (India) Private Limited**, which explicitly distributes and represents a massive list of global medical manufacturers and brands, or smaller regional Brazilian distributors named _Tecnomedi_ / _Tecnomed_ that handle brands like **ConvaTec** and **Welch Allyn**. [](https://technomed.net/product/model-sc-3008-dl-sequential-circulator/)

If you meant **Technomed (India)**, they represent the following manufacturers and brands:

- **Surgical & Aesthetic Brands:** MicroAire, LipoSaver, Silimed, Humeca, Surgiform, Arbrea Labs, Aesthetic Group, Tisurg, Apolex Tite, Bilumix, Emed, Acteon.

- **Medical & Compression Devices:** Bio Compression, Medco Manufacturing, Zeronitec, Koken, Insto, EZ Fan.

- **In-house / Proprietary Lines:** Recover, Slick, Ferret, Grippon, Anita. [](https://pressuregarment.com/)
